remarks:
Welcome to 28 Wimbledon Lane, a well-maintained townhouse located in the desirable Wimbledon Village community of West Seneca. This inviting home offers a comfortable and functional layout featuring two bedrooms, one and a half bathrooms, a full basement, and a two-car garage.

The main level offers a spacious living area with plenty of natural light and a comfortable flow between the living and dining spaces. The kitchen provides ample cabinetry and workspace, making it both practical for everyday living and well suited for entertaining.

Upstairs, the home features two well-proportioned bedrooms and a full bathroom. The full basement provides additional versatile space for storage, recreation, a home office, or other personal needs. A washer and dryer are conveniently located in the basement.

One of the standout features of the property is the two-car garage, offering secure parking along with additional storage space. The property is situated within the established Wimbledon Village community and offers convenient access to shopping, dining, parks, major roadways, and other West Seneca amenities.

With its functional layout, generous additional space, two-car garage, and convenient location, 28 Wimbledon Lane presents an excellent opportunity for comfortable living in West Seneca.

Showings begin Monday, 10/05 at 10:00 AM. Open House: Saturday, 10/10 from 12:00 PM–3:00 PM. Delayed Negotiations: All offers are due Monday, 10/12 at 12:00 PM.
